name: Open quotes follow-up list
summary: Each week the owner, sales lead or estimator gets one list from the quote status export: quotes never viewed, viewed with no answer, close to expiry, expired with no decision, and drafts never sent, by owner, each with a short follow-up draft. Totals are quoted amounts, never a forecast.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own original method for a weekly follow-up list of open quotes, read from a quoting tool's status export.
